svg.title: Figure 5-1: where each hazard's rated rows land on the PL scale
svg.desc: One line per hazard with five cells for the Performance Levels a to e; a dot in a cell for each rated row at that level, the cell coloured by level; at the right the number of high-risk rows and a bar of the measures the rows rely on, coloured by whether each exists today.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 5-1 Where each hazard's rated rows land on the Performance Level scale

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One line per hazard of §4; one dot per rated row of §5 at its adopted PLr (rows with no control function at their risk-graph value, hollow).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two right-hand columns say how many of the hazard's rows are high risk and how many of the measures they rely on exist today.
